evidence: Touches Tor integration and peer binding in src/init.cpp and functional tests; carries the P2P label.
rationale: Enforcing a dedicated onion bind prevents Tor connections from arriving on shared binds and inheriting unintended address-based whitelist permissions. As noted in the description, 'Tor peers arriving through shared or wildcard binds may be classified by IP and inherit address-based whitelist permissions', making this a meaningful fix for peer classification and access control.
